information_requirement_traceability.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

business_requirements.name: BR-01: Maintain Verified Customer Identity Profiles
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall maintain a persistent, verified customer profile containing unique identifiers and validated contact details to ensure order accountability and secure transaction processing.
business_requirements.business_objective: To uniquely identify the customer as the owner of the order and ensure accurate delivery routing.
business_requirements.business_value: Enables fraud prevention through authentication, ensures accurate delivery routing, and facilitates communication regarding order status and issues.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly states the purpose is to 'uniquely identify the customer as the owner of the order' and lists 'Unique Customer ID' and 'Contact Channels' as required details.

origin.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

success_measures.measure: Percentage of customer profiles with verified unique identifiers and valid contact channels.
Rate of successful user authentication prior to order confirmation.

policies_and_constraints: Customer consent must be obtained for data collection and usage.
Identity verification must comply with local data privacy regulations.
assumptions: The Customer provides accurate details during registration or order creation.
The Platform Operator has the capability to verify identity against Payment Provider data.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk of fraud if identity verification fails or is bypassed.
Dependency on Payment Provider data for identity validation.

business_requirements.name: BR-02: Ensure Accurate Delivery Address Management
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall manage and validate delivery addresses to ensure orders are routed to the correct residential or commercial locations with appropriate access instructions.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure accurate delivery routing and determine optimal delivery addresses and access instructions.
business_requirements.business_value: Prevents delivery failures, reduces operational costs associated with failed attempts, and ensures successful handover of goods.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR specifies that 'Delivery addresses must be residential or commercial locations with access' and are used to 'route orders to the correct location'.

origin.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders successfully routed to valid geocodable addresses.
Reduction in failed delivery attempts due to address errors.

policies_and_constraints: Delivery addresses must be residential or commercial locations with access.
Contact information must be current for urgent communication needs.
assumptions: Address details provided by the customer are sufficient for geocoding.
The logistics system can interpret access instructions (e.g., gate codes).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk of delivery failure if address is invalid or inaccessible.
Dependency on the Order Allocation Engine for routing logic.

business_requirements.name: BR-03: Facilitate Secure Communication Channels
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall maintain current contact channels (phone, email) to facilitate communication regarding order status, issues, confirmations, and exception handling.
business_requirements.business_objective: To enable communication regarding delivery updates and support calls for order-related issues.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures accountability for the order and facilitates contact for exception handling or cancellations, improving customer satisfaction.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states the purpose includes 'facilitate communication regarding order status, issues, or confirmations' and lists 'Contact Channels' as a required detail.

origin.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders with reachable contact information.
Response time to customer inquiries via contact channels.

policies_and_constraints: Contact information must be current for urgent communication needs.
Customer consent must be obtained for data collection and usage.
assumptions: The system can validate phone numbers and emails for reachability.
Customers update contact details when necessary.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk of communication failure if contact details are outdated.
Dependency on the Order Allocation Engine and Logistics System for routing notifications.

business_requirements.name: BR-04: Support Fraud Prevention and Risk Assessment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall integrate risk profile scores and identity verification data to authenticate users and prevent fraudulent activity before order confirmation.
business_requirements.business_objective: To authenticate the user for fraud prevention before order confirmation and support business decisions regarding order validity.
business_requirements.business_value: Protects the platform and customers from financial loss due to fraud and ensures the integrity of the transaction process.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR lists 'Risk Profile Score' as a required information detail and states the business decision supported is 'Authenticating the user for fraud prevention before order confirmation'.

origin.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

success_measures.measure: Accuracy of risk profile scoring in identifying high-risk transactions.

policies_and_constraints: Identity verification must comply with local data privacy regulations.
Customer consent must be obtained for data collection and usage.
assumptions: The Platform Operator has access to internal risk assessment logic.
Risk profile scores are updated based on customer behavior.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk of false positives blocking legitimate customers.
Dependency on Payment Provider data for identity validation.

business_requirements.name: BR-05: Ensure Data Privacy and Consent Compliance
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall obtain and record explicit customer consent for data collection and usage, ensuring compliance with local data privacy regulations.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure accountability for the order and facilitate contact for exception handling while adhering to legal and policy obligations.
business_requirements.business_value: Mitigates legal and reputational risk associated with non-compliance with data privacy laws and builds customer trust.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly lists 'Customer consent must be obtained for data collection and usage' and 'Identity verification must comply with local data privacy regulations' as functional rules.

origin.description: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods (phone, email).

success_measures.measure: Percentage of customer profiles with recorded explicit consent flags.
Number of compliance audits passed regarding data privacy.

policies_and_constraints: Customer consent must be obtained for data collection and usage.
Identity verification must comply with local data privacy regulations.
Data formats must comply with standard international protocols.
assumptions: The system can track consent flags explicitly.
Regulatory requirements vary by jurisdiction and must be configurable.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk of regulatory fines or penalties for non-compliance.
Risk of customer data breaches if consent management is flawed.
